findings.issue: The generated SVG uses the same global clipPath ID, supporting-head-clip, for every supporting actor instance.
findings.evidence: supportingHeadSvg() emits <clipPath id="supporting-head-clip"> for both model types and every rendered instance; SVG ID references are document-global, so duplicate IDs can cause one actor's clip definition to be selected for another.
findings.fix: Generate a unique, deterministic clipPath ID per actor instance or model registration and reference that ID from the corresponding group.
